data.one_liner: 2C2P payment gateway SDK for Flutter mobile apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows merchants to integrate 2C2P's payment gateway into Flutter mobile applications for payment processing. Protects sensitive payment information to comply with PCI-DSS standards.
use_when: You need to integrate 2C2P payment gateway into a Flutter mobile app
You want to avoid complex PCI-DSS certification processes for handling payments
avoid_when: you are using payment gateways other than 2C2P
You only need in-app purchases through Apple or Google stores
strengths: Provides access to a full suite of 2C2P payment options
Helps avoid complex and time-consuming PCI-DSS certification processes
weaknesses: Limited documentation directly in the README; relies heavily on external 2C2P developer portal links
data.setup_notes: Requires referring to the 2C2P developer portal for full SDK integration steps.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Stripe instead of 2C2P for payment processing.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need digital goods billing via Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
